My research focuses on probability, random graphs, stochastic processes and spectral methods, with applications to large-scale networks.

![](assets/research_picture.png){width=220px}

## Publications and Preprints

1. **Localization of Maximal Entropy Random Walk on $\mathbb{Z}^d$**,  
   Miklós Abért, Adam Arras, Jaelin Kim. *In preparation*.

2. **Large Deviations for Triangle Counts in Sparse Directed Random Graphs**,  
   Adam Arras, Pierfrancesco Dionigi. *In preparation*.
   
3. **Quenched Path Limits and Periodization Stability for Tilted Brownian Motion in Poissonian Potentials on $\mathbb{H}^d$**,  
   Miklós Abért, Adam Arras, Jaelin Kim. *arXiv preprint* (2026).  
   <https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18433>

4. **The Uniform Random Walk on Graphs, Loop Processes and Graphings**,  
   Miklós Abért, Adam Arras, Jaelin Kim. *arXiv preprint* (2025).  
   <https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.09166>

5. **Random Schrödinger Operators and Convolution on Wreath Products**,  
   Adam Arras. *arXiv preprint* (2025).  
   <https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.22485>

6. **Existence of Absolutely Continuous Spectrum for Galton–Watson Random Trees**,  
   Adam Arras, Charles Bordenave. *Communications in Mathematical Physics*
   **403** (2023), no. 1, 495–527.  
   <https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00220-023-04798-3>

7. **Spectral Measures of Random Operators**,  
   Adam Arras. PhD thesis, Aix-Marseille University (2023).  
   [PDF](assets/pdf/these.pdf)
